rows.summary: Enable app-server paginated threads, add occurrence search, and restore legacy full-history views.
Honor final-answer boundaries so queue-only child mail waits for the next turn while explicit injected work can reopen the current turn.
Parallelize bounded skill-root scans while preserving root precedence and deterministic errors.

Renders the submitted prompt into history before starting a user turn so input stays visible while turn/start waits on remote work. Every Code lacks both hooks (no pre-render frame in AppEvent::CodexOp, no render_before_submit/CodexOpTarget) and its input_submission has diverged (record_cancel_edit_candidate, unconditional display), so port to Every Code's submission flow.
Generate bounded skills from legacy plugin command Markdown during installation without displacing native skills.
Skip an upstream-only snapshot-test refactor for a world-state module absent from the target.
Expand external-agent import with connector candidates, Cursor, memory, stable errors, and provider attribution.
Overlap public-directory and workspace connector fetches to remove serial latency.
Overlap executor-owned MCP and connector declaration reads in the selected-capability path.
Append source=codex only to OpenAI developer-docs MCP traffic.
Refresh host skill catalogs after thread start while emitting only changed world-state fragments.
Propagate ready-environment capability roots into MCP and warn when duplicate root IDs resolve to conflicting locations.
Do not port the transient GeneratedDefault filesystem variants; the later commit removes them and the target already uses the final direct-enforcement model.
Adopt the paginated subagent inherited-prefix/history_base model, but adapt around Every Code agent/session/product flows.
Shut down each approval-scenario Codex thread while preserving verification failures.
Use the elevated Windows sandbox automatically whenever managed proxy enforcement is active.
Retain Every Code's standalone network-proxy loader and managed-policy fallback instead of deleting the API and tests.
Adds cache-write input token accounting across protocol usage, analytics, OTEL, rollout handling, app-server schemas, exec output, and the TypeScript SDK.
Relocate external-agent migration service ownership from app-server into the dedicated crate.
Use final-answer agent messages for paginated turn summaries instead of commentary fallback.
Increase image-generation code-mode wait guidance to 120 seconds while preserving result handling.
Detect forced rm through wrappers and complex shell syntax, requiring approval or a safer rejection even without sandboxing.
Template-ID removal needs no local change because Every Code never carries that MCP call metadata field.
Expose cache-write input tokens in raw response usage schemas and expectations.
Preserve MCP text marked as encrypted content in function-call output items and give it precedence over structured content.
Unify multi-agent enablement and limits under agents, apply configured spawn defaults, and validate the final model/reasoning pair after role application.
Keep Every Code's agent_type surface because built-in and installed external roles make the override applicable without user-defined roles.
Add bounded BM25, character n-gram, multi-query, RRF, and routing-card selectors to the shadow skill-routing experiment.
Add bounded guidance for when to wait on starting execution environments and retain it across world-state updates.
Deletes the upstream realtime WebRTC crate and its dependency graph as an unused-code cleanup.
Suppress duplicate cached app/list update notifications while retaining initial and forced refresh updates.
Allow parallel write_stdin calls for different terminals while serializing each terminal and preventing active-session pruning.
Add app/read metadata lookup, caching, tool summaries, dark icons, install data, and plugin display names.
Reapply persisted agent roles when lazily reloading durable V2 subagents while preserving live approval, cwd, and permission state.
Refresh per-step AGENTS and world state for every session while keeping each active turn's selected environments fixed.
Restrict code-mode image helper output to data URLs while preserving Every Code's integrated code-mode runtime.
Propagate trusted thread originators into standalone web-search and image-generation requests.
Use the neutral apply_patch tool description while retaining Every Code's existing patch grammar and prompt guidance.
Preserve project scope and source provenance when importing external-agent memory.

Pure refactor extracting the four ApprovalRequest enum variants (Exec, Permissions, ApplyPatch, McpElicitation) into named payload structs with routing/rendering updated to use them. No behavior/UX change; Every Code still carries the inline-field enum form with the same fields, so the port is mechanical and keeps the approval overlay aligned with upstream.
Upstream recency migration repair optimization targets a migration hook absent from Every Code's remapped migration lineage.
Decide whether Every Code should permit custom Bedrock endpoint, command-auth, and header overrides before adapting provider and account UX.

Multi-agent V2 feature: adds a Thread.canAcceptDirectInput capability across app-server-protocol and app-server, then threads it through the TUI to present parent-owned sub-agent threads as view-only (preserve drafts/queued input, block agent-directed commands/settings, keep navigation). Not present in Every Code and spans protocol+app-server+tui, so defer pending Every Code's multi-agent V2 posture.
Increase the zsh fork-decline integration-test command timeout from five to twenty seconds.
Add app/installed for effective connector runtime state with thread-scoped policy and refresh support.

Adds a confirmation popup before redeeming a selected usage-limit reset, backend-provided reset titles/descriptions, and idempotency/dedup handling. This entire usage-limit reset redemption feature does not exist in Every Code (no chatwidget/usage.rs or reset_credits.rs, no UsageLimitReset events); Every Code uses its own rate-limit model-switch prompt, so this OpenAI redemption flow should not be imported.
Measure serialized structured web-search result payload sizes.
Batch executor capability discovery into one bounded RPC and shared snapshot.
Defer transcript-tail provenance tagging until Every Code adopts the corresponding realtime tail-flush and V3 handoff path.
Defer realtime V3 handoff streaming, response-channel routing, and bounded initial items until the missing V3 substrate is staged.
Disable ShellSnapshot in the default core test harness and isolate approval scenarios with named in-memory thread stores.
Add the Unix regression test that proves separate exec-server workspaces permit own writes and deny cross-workspace writes.
No port is needed for an empty MultiAgentMode custom hint because Every Code has no matching mode-hint pipeline.
Do not synchronize upstream test deletions that only restate feature-registry metadata.
Remove the dead dispatch_any convenience wrapper and make test-only absent terminal outcomes explicit.
Add the long-yield grace period to Every Code's code-mode initial execute and wait/poll timers.
Delete the stale ignored explorer-role and unified-exec tests still retained by the target.

Sequential jif dead-code cleanup pair: remove the redundant word_wrap_lines_borrowed helper (routing borrowed slices through word_wrap_lines) and remove the unused PairProgramming/Execute CollaborationModeIndicator footer variants, leaving Plan as the only rendered indicator. Both are dead_code-annotated in the worktree; no behavior/UX change.
Defer the ordered migration of collaboration, realtime, and permission prompts into persisted WorldState diffs until Every Code adopts a bounded context-state foundation.

One-line upstream fix setting the external-agent config import 'source' field to "cli" while still passing the adapter via 'migration_source'. Every Code's ExternalAgentConfigImportParams has diverged and only carries migration_items — there are no source/migration_source fields — so the disambiguation has no target here.
Defer the thread-owned McpRuntime refactor until it lands with the adapted MCP catalog and resource-client lifecycle.
Bound rollout metadata reads to headers; rollout listing already does this, doctor parity still full-loads rollouts.
Run bounded SessionEnd hooks during root-thread teardown across app-server shutdown paths.
Expose nullable plugin installation-interstitial requirements through catalog and app-server summary paths.

Supports ChatGPT-branded Desktop builds: macOS accepts both ChatGPT.app and Codex.app (com.openai.codex bundles), Windows resolves the protocol executable from the AppX manifest instead of a hardcoded Codex.exe, and user-facing text switches 'Codex Desktop' to 'Desktop app'. Adopt the Windows manifest-resolution robustness fix, but map the branding text to Every Code product naming rather than take 'Desktop app' verbatim.
Adds bounded, byte-aware batch lookups for newest-to-oldest JSONL message-history scans.

Optimizes reverse-search over persistent history: probes the newest entry, scans older history in bounded batches cached by absolute offset, preserves continuation cursors, ignores stale responses, retries failed batch reads, and restores the draft without a false 'no match' when history is unavailable. Adds a chat_composer_history/search_batch module. Self-contained perf/robustness improvement to an existing Every Code feature.
Launches managed network proxies inside remote executor processes and propagates proxy configuration through sandbox and exec-server protocols.
Allow LISTED discoverability when publishing plugins through share updates.

Dependent upstream pair hardening the agent picker: preserve sub-agent liveness via terminal 'stopped' tracking (#33921) and allow selecting path-backed agents by canonical path while skipping duplicate liveness refreshes (#33922). Every Code's agent picker is a deliberately simpler divergent model (AgentPickerThreadEntry = nickname/role/is_closed) with no liveness rendering, no stopped_threads, and no path-backed subagent concept, so the bugs they fix cannot occur here.
Add audio user-input variants and carry audio outputs through dynamic tools, MCP, code mode, and app-server history.

Adds inline visualization rendering: recognizes ::codex-inline-vis directives in assistant Markdown, rewrites them to browser links across streaming/finalized/replay, and materializes HTML fragments in a sandboxed CSP viewer (~2100 lines incl. inline_visualization.rs + assets). Every Code has none of this and instead pursues a terminal-native ASCII visualization philosophy (TERMINAL_VISUALIZATION_INSTRUCTIONS), so this is a large new feature partly at odds with Every Code intent.
Fix quoted Windows hook commands by passing cmd.exe command text as a raw argument.
Small audio-search and Bazel unit-test-args cleanup is nonblocking until matching upstream audio/search or Bazel targets land.
Carry audio inputs through Responses requests, modality filtering, compaction/history, dynamic tools, and thread previews without requiring a new TUI attachment UX.
SQLite connection behavior is already centralized in Every Code runtime.rs, though not via upstream's extracted sqlite.rs file.

Adds a persisted tui.resume_cwd preference (current|session) so resume/fork can remember the cwd choice and skip the prompt, with config schema, edit/persistence, --cd honoring, and remote-workspace rejection. Every Code already has a richer one-time cwd prompt and resolve/rebuild pipeline (CwdSelection, resolve_cwd_for_resume_or_fork) but no persisted setting; the remember-my-choice persistence is the missing piece to adapt without disturbing account/settings flows.
Refreshes bundled model metadata, including GPT-5.6 context limits, reasoning support, skills instructions, permissions, and model messages.
Add turn, retry-count, retry-limit, and stream-error fields to sampling retry warnings.
Makes doctor thread-inventory parity checks understand compressed rollout siblings, canonical paths, temporary files, and unreadable compressed data.

Renders streamed Markdown incrementally: retains rendered output for completed top-level blocks and rerenders only the final mutable block, with canonical full-render fallback when source-wide state changes. Adds streaming/render.rs and markdown_render/streaming.rs. Every Code's streaming stack is architecturally divergent (markdown_stream.rs + streaming/{chunking,commit_tick,table_holdback}.rs), so this needs reimplementation, not a port.

Small self-contained fix: normal-mode reasoning shortcuts emit only AppEvent::UpdateReasoningEffort(next) instead of reapplying the current model via apply_model_and_effort_without_persist, avoiding an unnecessary model resend. Every Code still calls apply_model_and_effort_without_persist and already defines AppEvent::UpdateReasoningEffort, so this is a clean one-line adopt.

Avoids redundant TUI redraws while streaming: redraw stream tails only when a completed line changes the visible tail, cache the first reasoning header, and make set_status/set_status_header return whether a redraw was requested. Every Code already implements its own redraw-avoidance via a distinct active_stream_tail mechanism and its set_status APIs return unit, so this is a perf refinement to reconcile, not a straight port.

Makes thread_to_transcript_cells consume Thread by value to move (not clone) turn items into transcript history cells. Every Code has the equivalent in resume_picker/transcript.rs with a `&Thread` signature and no codex_home/inline-visualization param, so the clone-avoidance applies but must be ported to the divergent module layout and simpler signature.

Uses MarkdownStreamCollector as the streaming source of truth: commit_complete_source returns byte ranges and finalize_and_take_source replaces finalize_and_drain_source, removing the controller's raw_source buffer. Applies to Every Code's markdown_stream.rs/streaming controller but must be ported against local divergence and re-verified.

Dependent pair for side conversations: fork with exclude_turns so the child UI starts empty instead of replaying the parent's turns (#34198), then avoid liveness races when selecting the fresh fork by seeding agent navigation from the fork response and skipping redundant liveness/parent-title reads for cached side threads (#34199). Every Code has the side-conversation feature but the plain fork_thread path, so both apply and must land together.

Makes insert_history_hyperlink_lines_with_mode_and_wrap_policy accept a &[HyperlinkLine] slice and borrow pending batches instead of cloning each batch's Vec. Small self-contained borrow-instead-of-clone change that applies cleanly.

Stops retaining decoded MCP images in history cells: validate/decode then return a marker cell without storing the DynamicImage. Rendered placeholder is unchanged, so the memory-saving change applies cleanly.

Speeds up Markdown layout: bulk table column-width allocation (shrink_columns), reuse of flattened line data during adaptive wrapping, and a single-scan hyperlink remap. Larger algorithmic refactor across markdown_render.rs/wrapping.rs/terminal_hyperlinks.rs that should be ported and re-tested carefully.

Keeps incremental streaming render active when an inline visualization context is present but no directive appears in the source. Every Code has no inline-visualization feature and no streaming/render.rs, so the branch this fixes does not exist.

Tracks exec command completion by recorded duration (not output presence), drops the redundant CommandOutput.formatted_output field, and coalesces exploration reads without cloning calls. Applies to Every Code's exec_cell but exec-cell rendering is a UX-sensitive divergence area, so port with snapshot review.

Avoids buffering replay-irrelevant thread notifications (raw response items, realtime audio, progress deltas) and borrows notifications when recording for an active thread. Applies to Every Code's thread_events, but the skip-list references many ServerNotification variants whose presence in Every Code's protocol must be verified during porting.

Adds a single-width MarkdownRenderCache for finalized agent messages and proposed plans, invalidated on width/theme/terminal-color changes. The perf win applies but Every Code's AgentMarkdownCell has no inline_visualization_context field, so the visualization-directive bypass must be dropped/simplified when porting.

Avoids cloning FileChange values in TUI diff rendering by consuming/sorting DiffSummary entries and borrowing paths/changes in the shared Row representation. Applies but diff rendering is an Every Code UX-sensitive area, so port and verify output unchanged.
Backfill completion items only after an exec notification is matched to the active primary turn.
Persist paginated thread names, Git metadata, and memory mode in SQLite; Every Code has related paths but not the upstream schema/edge cases.

Adds HistoryCell::has_stable_transcript_height and remeasures dynamic cells in the transcript overlay, preventing clipping of refreshed status/rate-limit output. Every Code's pager_overlay.rs uses the pre-refactor CellRenderable shape and lacks the trait method; the status-remeasure half is relevant while the inline-visualization test/snapshot is not applicable.

Skips loaded-subagent backfill for fresh/forked threads and reuses backfill-collected status when opening the agent picker to avoid duplicate thread/read requests. Every Code has the matching infra (last_subagent_backfill_attempt, refresh_agent_picker_thread_liveness) so the optimization applies, but session_lifecycle.rs has diverged around resume/fork so it needs adaptation.
Migrates legacy exact allow rules from the default exec-policy file once, preserving user-created rules and respecting ignored-policy settings.
Preserve writable zsh tied PATH exports in shell snapshots while excluding readonly tied exports.
Reject an unsupported canonical rollout history mode before copied fork metadata can mask it.
Removes unused Rust APIs, test helpers, dependencies, and obsolete sandbox-summary and daemon entry points.

Tracks inline visualization directives in StreamingRender (streaming/render.rs) so the canonical full-source renderer stays active once a directive is committed. Every Code has no streaming/render.rs and no inline-visualization directive path, so there is nothing to modify.

Avoids cloning deferred lifecycle/approval payloads by moving them into the interrupt queue or immediate handler, borrowing MCP elicitation metadata, and consuming apply-patch changes after collecting paths. All target files exist in Every Code; pure perf/allocation refactor with low product risk, adapt to local signatures.

Builds one chat-widget renderable tree per frame and caches each flex child's desired height by width, reusing the bottom pane's renderable directly. Every Code's render/renderable.rs has the FlexRenderable/desired_height plumbing but no per-frame height cache, and app.rs/rendering.rs are diverged (side panel, pets), so adapt rather than clean-pick.

Parallelizes bootstrap by tokio::try_join'ing model/list with configRequirements/read. Every Code's bootstrap is diverged: it reads the account then model/list sequentially and never issues configRequirements/read, so there is no co-located config request to overlap and the optimization has no target.

Dependent exec-output pair: encapsulate aggregated command output behind preview/transcript iterator APIs (#34357), then use them to bound live output (retain <=1 MiB then first/last 50 lines + partial, bound long lines on UTF-8/ANSI boundaries, show omitted counts) via a new exec_cell/live_output.rs (#34359). Every Code's exec_cell/model.rs stores a raw unbounded aggregated_output String; a real UX-safety improvement to adapt to Every Code's exec rendering.
Avoid cloning reconstructed thread history when attributing restored token usage on resume and fork.

Net-new ~1.7k-line reasoning-effort UX: composer/status-line ignition animations for Max/Ultra, a distinct Ultra prompt glyph and tier accent, reduced-motion/color fallbacks. New effort_ignition*/effort_status_line* modules are absent from Every Code, which has its own reasoning-effort UX; this changes product-facing composer prompt/status presentation and needs product sign-off.

Adds a borrowed Line conversion used when rendering/measuring hyperlink-aware history and pager content to avoid cloning span strings. Every Code has the target files but no borrowed-line helper yet; pure perf, style-preserving, adapt to local line_utils API.

Uses codex_app_server_protocol::SkillMetadata directly across skill toggles/mentions/submission and drops the protocol-to-core conversion and codex-core-skills TUI dep. Every Code still has protocol_skill_to_core/path_to_skills_md/codex_core_skills, so the refactor is unapplied; skills is a product flow, so adapt and verify protocol SkillMetadata field parity.

Clears pending Guardian review state on both turn completion and finalization, restoring an active MCP-startup header (or 'Working') afterward, via new clear()/clear_guardian_review_status() and a factored mcp_startup_status_header(). Guardian infra is present in Every Code but lacks these; a real stale-state bugfix that applies cleanly.
Extends second-based OTEL latency histogram boundaries through 12, 15, 20, 30, 60, and 120 seconds.
Avoid duplicate generated-image rendering by moving file hints to the image-generation artifact output and leaving the extension as the result owner.
Stop replacing invalid tool images with placeholder text and retrying; surface the bad-request error without mutating history.
Makes Responses WebSocket request construction borrow shared request fields instead of cloning the full model input payload.
Marks multi-agent v2 stable while keeping it disabled by default and removes it from under-development feature warnings.
Upgrade the packaged ripgrep manifest from 15.1.0 to 15.2.0 for every supported target.
Adds GPT-5.6 personality instruction variables, a GPT-5.5 availability notice, and removes obsolete catalog message fields.
Route the default hosted Codex Apps MCP server through plugin-service ps/mcp while preserving Every Code's configured override and integration boundaries.
Make ContextManager history snapshots copy-on-write to eliminate deep copies while retaining existing mutation semantics.
Port the related Windows writable-root ACL correctness and elevated-runner startup hardening as one platform-specific stack.
Add per-hook additional-context spill limits across hook config, model context handling, app-server responses, and the hooks browser.
Run queued SessionStart hooks after successful mid-turn compaction before continuation, honoring hook context and stop requests.
Propagate bounded approval rejection reasons through protocol and tool results while preserving Every Code Guardian and MCP approval UX.
Do not port upstream-only audio-history and hook-struct test adjustments to APIs absent from Every Code.
Import lineage-aware paginated history: segment resolver, turn boundaries, cross-segment paging, reference-safe cleanup, and model-context loading.
Allow threadless MCP operations to run without synthetic event channels and auto-decline elicitations.
Run Linux /proc mount preflight with the minimal read-only filesystem instead of the command policy view.
Reject upstream removal of CSV-backed agent jobs because Every Code exposes the fanout tools and their config/state compatibility surfaces.

Reformats completed hook headers to inline the first warning line as `LABEL (status) says: <text>` with remaining lines indented, and stops double-rendering warning entries. Every Code's hook_cell.rs has already diverged (renders `{label} hook ({status})` with a generic prefix loop and no warning dedup); cosmetic-only, defer pending a decision on Every Code hook UX.
Defer the coherent exec-server process-sandbox migration: Windows sandbox execution plus custom arg0 preservation through sandbox wrappers.
Move shared skill data models from core-skills into the lower-level codex-skills crate.
Adapt remote-compaction token accounting and trace snapshot optimizations to Every Code's compaction and hook/runtime paths.
Adds catalog approval-message variants for never and unless_trusted policies with fallback and explicit-empty suppression semantics.
Builds the route-aware HTTP foundation: explicit outbound proxy resolution, pooled clients, separate request execution and logging, redirect re-resolution, and focused coverage.
Honor network settings from managed permission profiles when resolving the active network proxy.
Increase patch-approval integration-test waits to tolerate legitimate slow approval events.
Adapt buffered code-mode exec defaults and model-visible timeout guidance to Every Code's existing code-mode runtime.
Expose optional age and count limits for external-session detection while retaining 30-day and 50-session defaults.
Add alpha-hotfix version conversion and validation across Every Code's runtime, release, and installer paths.
Complete settings snapshot persistence for goal-first and forked threads without overriding Every Code's thread-goal and resume semantics.
Propagate CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO through managed MITM CA bundle handling for Cargo child processes.
Migrates backend, cloud-task, daemon-updater, and LM Studio traffic to policy-aware shared clients and documents the intended HTTP-client construction rules.
Decide whether and how Every Code should mirror owned release artifacts, metadata channels, and stable installer aliases to R2.
Route plugin startup-sync and remote-plugin HTTP traffic through the configured system and PAC-aware client.
Adapt optional alternate-source installer downloads, fallback handling, and binary-version verification to Every Code's owned release layout.
Do not add an unused codespell exception for absent Symphonia code.
Do not port a Wine PTY-test argument change when the target has no matching Wine test.
Modularize MCP manager internals and bind tool calls to captured catalog revisions while resources follow the latest runtime.
Carry step-scoped extension state through compaction and centralize persisted compacted-item construction while retaining Every Code's session/thread/turn stores.
Detaches Git fsmonitor probes and timed repository-metadata commands from inherited stdin.
Do not port Noise handshake buffer sizing into an exec-server transport that has no matching noise_channel implementation.
Add regression coverage for thread-scoped MCP refresh overrides and non-mutating strict refreshes.

Coherent jif dead-code cleanup chain: remove the unused RestoreMode enum so Tui::with_restored always keeps raw mode (#34551), remove the unused RtOptions::line_ending/width setters and their #[allow(dead_code)] (#34552), and remove the never-constructed AppCommand::Shutdown variant/helper and its replay handling (#34553). All three are missing in the worktree and are safe, order-independent cleanups.
Do not synchronize upstream deletion of ignored cloud-task, delegated-approval, and unified-exec tests that remain useful in Every Code.
Adds authenticated Codex user-settings retrieval for both Codex API and ChatGPT backend route styles with cache bypass and compatibility defaults.

Maps .cu/.cuh (and already cppm/cxxm/ixx) to C++ syntax highlighting in the TUI diff renderer. Every Code's find_syntax is a leaner variant that omits upstream's cppm/cxxm/ixx patches and relies on two-face, so cu/cuh is unmapped; low-risk highlighting improvement, adopt by adding the alias into the smaller patched-match table.
Accept the forward-compatible forceRefetch boolean on plugin/list requests without changing behavior yet.

Gates tui::restore behind #[cfg(unix)] since it is only used by the Unix job-control suspend path, avoiding a dead-code warning on Windows. Trivial platform-gating cleanup; couples with the RestoreMode removal (#34551) because Every Code's RestoreMode::Full still references restore().
Adds keyed, case-insensitive shell-environment include and exclude filters with layered-config replacement and validation semantics.
Enforce exact managed config values across runtime, app-server writes, locks, debug UI, and PathUri documentation.
Defer generalized skip-missing filesystem sandbox entries until Every Code's permission and exec-server protocols can carry the new behavior.
Sanitize explicit and implicit skill names before emitting skill-injection metric tags.
Permit explicitly allowlisted loopback targets through the managed proxy while retaining private-network protections.

Lets `/new <name>` and `/clear <name>` name the freshly created session: NewSession/ClearUi gain an optional name, slash_dispatch parses trailing text, and start_fresh_session_with_summary_hint sets it via thread/name/set, reporting naming failures inline. Every Code already provides naming via `/rename`+set_thread_name and its session-lifecycle signatures differ, so adapt and reconcile with the existing rename flow.
Unify compatibility-aware skill rendering with context-scaled budgets, fair description trimming, and description-free fallback before omission.
Redirects doctor reports, doctor Git commands, rollout searches, and Windows sandbox refresh helpers to null stdin.
Defer the large Windows managed-proxy ingress and restricting-SID routing architecture as a staged platform workstream.
Do not port the upstream test-only missing-path initializer without its absent sandbox-entry schema migration.
Defer exec-server network-policy callback types until Every Code has an end-to-end remote decision consumer and user policy flow.
Increase the auto-review model-override integration-test completion wait to fifteen seconds.
Uses Windows job objects to terminate descendants on cancellation while preserving background descendants after normal root exit, with corresponding inherited-FD test updates.

Fixes Windows TUI navigation keys by keeping the console in Win32 input-record mode (clearing/reasserting ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_INPUT while polling), disabling focus-change reporting on Windows, and restoring the original VT-input bit on shutdown via a new windows_console module. Platform bug fix with no product/UX or account-flow impact; all new code is cfg(windows)-gated.
Route agent-identity registration and JWKS requests through the shared HTTP client.

Keeps the TUI running when app-server turn/start is rejected for a pending user turn: the CodexOp handler catches TypedRequestError::Server{method=="turn/start"}, calls handle_turn_start_rejection to finalize the turn and surface the error in-transcript, and only exits on unhandled errors (also adds a test-only screen_size_override). Every Code's event_dispatch/turn_runtime differ, so adapt.
Attributes review findings to materially supporting repository instructions while preserving ordinary findings and deduplicating rule support.
Complete managed-proxy setup hardening for Linux sandboxes, WebSocket proxy variables, and scoped attribution cleanup.
Moves login and auth refresh traffic onto shared policy-aware HTTP construction and requires resolved route configuration through auth managers and cloud flows.
Verify SHA-pinned Git plugin checkouts resolve exactly to the requested commit.
Adapt upstream always-on response item IDs to Every Code's already-persisted canonical-ID and provider-specific request policy.
Defer core test-support migration to the shared HTTP client until Every Code has that client foundation.
Preserves PathUri values through patch deltas and turn-diff tracking so foreign POSIX, Windows, UNC, and opaque paths render portably.
Preserve the latest persisted approvals reviewer when forking, even across an earlier-turn boundary.
Add Codex session-id and thread-id headers to realtime WebSocket and WebRTC starts without replacing Every Code's existing realtime headers.
Adds action-risk review policy, policy prompt, and approval and permission messages to the codex-auto-review catalog entry.
Rename the MCP connection collection to McpConnectionSet while retaining the compatibility alias.
Adapt unified-exec lifecycle ordering fixes to Every Code's output-closure, network-denial, and interaction-event architecture.
Skip Git enrichment for startup prewarm and Guardian review turns while retaining fresh metadata for regular turns.
Remove step-scoped extension data after moving required MCP resource capability to session-owned state.
